findings.note: Ball is listed among the additional sponsors of House Bill 1246, Safeguarding Elections Act, filed 7/30/2026. Section 2(b) adds a misdemeanor for any person to demand citizenship documentation from a voter other than what State law requires at any point during the voting process. The bill text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/HTML/H1246v1.html) also makes voter photo identification images and photocopies of identification for voting confidential records. Referred to House Rules committee 8/4/2026.

election integrity laws in general
